revert_description: This will revert your server's Docker image back to the egg's default specification.
revert_warning: You will not be able to set a custom image back without contacting support.
revert_confirm: Are you sure you want to continue?
startup_description: Configure how your server starts up. These settings control the startup command and environment variables.
exercise_caution: Exercise caution when modifying these settings.
startup_command_description: Configure the command that starts your server. You can edit the raw command or view the processed version with variables resolved.
command_placeholder: Enter startup command with variables like {{SERVER_MEMORY}} or {{SERVER_PORT}}...
live_preview_placeholder: Enter a command to see the live preview...
docker_image_description: The container image used to run your server. Different images provide different software versions and configurations.
custom_image_notice: This server's Docker image has been manually set by an administrator and cannot be changed through this interface.
custom_image_revert_notice: You can revert to the egg's default image, but you won't be able to set it back without contacting support.
env_variables_description: Configure environment variables that will be available to your server. These variables can be used to customize server behavior and settings.
